title: Cohomology system of ideal powers
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $\mathcal J\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent ideal and $\mathcal F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module. Using the ideal products and powers of [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] (0), set $P_0=\mathcal F$, $P_n=\mathcal J^n\mathcal F$ for $n\ge1$, and let $\iota_n:P_n\to\mathcal F$ be the inclusion (the identity for $n=0$). For $k\ge n$, the canonical inclusion $P_k\to P_n$ is the unique map whose composite with $\iota_n$ is $\iota_k$. For a commutative ring $A$, an ideal $I\subseteq A$ and $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$, take $\mathcal J=I\mathcal O_X$, the extension [def-nagata-extended-ideal] of the ideal sheaf associated to $I$. For $q\ge0$, define $M_n=H^q(X,P_n)$ using [pqf-def-cohomology], with scalars restricted from $\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ to $A$ along $f^\sharp$. The transition map $\mu_{k,n}:M_k\to M_n$ is $H^q$ of the canonical inclusion $P_k\to P_n$.
